name: Unbiased Line Integration
aliases: Transformed equidistant sampling for line integration
Unbiased line integration along a ray
definition: An unbiased estimator for the transmittance-weighted integral C along a light ray starting at surface intersection point x_∂V with direction ω, defined as C = c_∂V(x_∂V)τ(x ↔ x_∂V) + ∫_0^||x_∂V - x|| c_V(x - tω)τ(x → x - tω) dt.
summary: Unbiased Line Integration estimates transmittance-weighted integrals in participating media using transformed equidistant sampling to remain perfectly unbiased unlike biased ray marching.
